title: End-of-Sale & End-of-Life Notice for Zscaler Cloud Identity Entitlement Management

blocks.text: Zscaler is announcing the End-of-Sale (EOS) and End-of-Life (EOL) dates for Zscaler Cloud Identity Entitlement Management (CIEM).
As of October 18, 2022, licenses for new CIEM subscriptions will not be available for purchase. The CIEM service and all existing tenants will continue to be supported until the EOL date.

If you are using CIEM, you should consider a migration plan to Zscaler Posture Control (ZPC)—the new generation platform, covering CIEM functionality and multiple additional modules and features. The ZPC service is now available for CIEM customers with no extra charge for the remainder of the subscription period.
Contact Zscaler Support to devise a migration plan.
To learn more about Zscaler Posture Control (ZPC), see https://www.zscaler.com/products/posture-control. If you have additional questions, contact Zscaler Support.
